notes.title: English language update
notes.content:
Hello from those of us at Tales~Shop!

We've got a new update for Miracle Snack Shop!

1. We have updated our previous translation with a newer one that will help create a more immersive and enjoyable experience for you!

We've also fixed:

2. A few spelling and grammar errors in various places
3. And fixed a few bugs that we have found.

As always, thank you for your interest in Tales~Shop!

notes.title: update v1.0.1 / 앞으로 계획
notes.content:
---- update v1.0.1




- Fixed an error that Mira's dialog did not appear in certain events.

- Updated to make it easier to enter Mira Route without special conditions.

- Other minor errors have been fixed.







---- update v1.0.2 




- UI improvements / UI sound effects added.

- Changed to more intuitive game texts font.

- Fixed minor minor issues.







---- Upcoming OST Sales Plan




- Includes: OST 18 songs (wav + mp3) + rough image + high resolution in-game CG

- The character vocal song for Philia will be updated on the upcoming extended DLC scheduled for March.

- $ 4.99

notes.title: miracle snack shop DLC
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34060786/ce037ac783162f1bbf9844126aa1fd3100957e9f.png[/img]


We decided to make a "miracle snack shop" DLC.

Contents included in DLC are as follows.

- Additional events (more than 100 A4 pages)
- Additional costumes
- Additional Event CG
- Phillia vocal theme song

DLC will be released in March!
